entries.what: The missing operator is no longer accepted in data_collection_params on List conversations and Resolve conversation reference. The parameter itself stays live.

source.quote: data_collection_params no longer accepts the missing operator. Use an empty value to match conversations where the field was not collected.

lookFor: A data_collection_params filter of the form id:missing, on the same line as the parameter
entries.replacement: An empty value: id:eq: matches conversations where the field was not collected, and id:neq: where it was.

entries.what: Knowledge base document responses no longer carry auto_discover in auto_sync_info.

source.quote: Knowledge base document responses - auto_sync_info removes the deprecated auto_discover field.

entries.replacement: None listed on the provider page when this was added

entries.what: Get crawl job responses no longer carry max_depth. Create crawl job still takes it as a no-op, so only a read of the response is dead.

source.quote: Get crawl job - Removed the deprecated max_depth response field.

lookFor: max_depth read off a crawl job
entries.replacement: None listed on the provider page when this was added

future.what: The sound effects model eleven_text_to_sound_v2 will be removed.

source.quote: eleven_text_to_sound_v2 is deprecated and will be removed on March 1, 2027.

requires: It is the default model today: a request that doesn't set model_id needs to set it explicitly, and no matcher finds those.
